rationale.conceptual: The underlying method combines several established but non-trivial components (Mansoori-Canfield free-energy minimization, correlation energy from Landau theory, Green's function N(E_F), Faber-Ziman resistivity) into a self-consistent procedure. Implementing these correctly requires solid understanding of condensed-matter theory and careful numerical coding, extending beyond a textbook exercise.
rationale.execution: Two sequential steps (pure metal parameters then alloy properties) with straightforward CSV output. No complex orchestration, external tooling, or heavy data handling; the pipeline is simple and can be implemented in a single script.
